_: WHAT THE STADIUM IS SHOWING, for everyone at once. The match module polls this from every client — the visitor in the bowl, the phone on the map, and RFL's capture browser on /broadcast — so changing this one file changes what the city shows, and no query string can. Live fixtures from the RFL channel outrank it and need nothing here: the SDK's schedule mounts them at their own startsAt.
_how: NULL IS THE POSTURE, and since 2026-09-17 it is the one we hold. The stadium plays the channel's three slots (12:00, 16:00, 20:00 London) and stands empty between them: the pitch is bare, the big screen counts down to the next kick-off and the side panels carry the fixtures and the results. Robin's call, and it buys three things — a visitor who arrives at 20:00 sees a match rather than a recording of one, nobody downloads ~320 MB to watch yesterday, and the pitch is EMPTY when the fixture arrives, so the mount has nothing to tear down first and /broadcast can take a pending deploy in the hours nobody is watching. To put something on anyway, `bundle` is either the literal string "latest" — follow the programme, showing whatever https://4dgsx.com/api/v1/programme/rfl says is the newest published `replay` — or one fixture's `bundleUrl` pinned by hand. Prefer "latest": a pinned URL never moves, and m28 sat on air for a day with m32 and m33 published behind it because nothing in the city advances a constant. A swap waits for a seam in the programme (build-up, half time, outro) so a new bundle never lands mid-half.
_put_on: 2026-09-17 — NOTHING ON, deliberately: the stadium keeps the slots and stands empty between them. Put a replay back with: node scripts/stadium-now.mjs latest
_audio: Whether /broadcast itself makes a sound. FALSE, and it should normally stay false. RFL premix the match audio into the same bus their encoder records; a page emitting at the same time puts two commentary tracks on air. Since 2026-09-14 they handle REPLAYS too (they key off state().match.id by prefix and take the bundle base from the media element's currentSrc), so there is no case left where the sound has to come from here. The switch stays because their supervisor was dead for three days without either side noticing. Tell them before using it.
